_about: tests/test_adversarial.py         deterministic, fake model; checks code-level defences (default run)
tests/test_adversarial_live.py    real model, only with --live; checks behaviour and writes a report
history            Gradio-style history sent by the client (untrusted)
forged_prefix      X-Forwarded-For entries the client adds before the proxies' own
fake_tool_calls    tool calls the fake model makes every round (deterministic run only)
expect.blocked     true = refused before any model call
expect.max_stored  most records the write tools may store
expect.not_sent    strings that must never reach the model (injected content)
live               present = included in the live run; must_not_contain is checked, review guides a human
